name: Superior
description: The Superior was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer belonging to the Imperial Remnant's naval fleet. In 28 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Superior participated in the Battle of Bastion, in which the Yuuzhan Vong assaulted the Imperial capital planet of Bastion in the Sartinaynian system. Fighting alongside the Star Destroyer Chimaera over a gas giant in the star system, the Superior was ravaged by the attacks of Yuuzhan Vong starships, and its wreck was lost as it fell into the gas giant's atmosphere.
